move: kicker tracks in, scrambled glyphs resolve to the title, flicker lock, scramble-out
how: A contrasty sunset background with vignette and scanlines, a red kicker, a huge uppercase title and a date line. The kicker fades in from letter-spacing 1em (expo.out, first 30%). ScrambleTextPlugin resolves the title from random uppercase glyphs to the final string over 50% of the duration (revealDelay 0.15, ease none) and the date line from digit/slash noise to its text from 25% to 70%; a red progress bar scales x to full. At 57% the title flickers opacity 0.3 four times, then at 82% scrambles out to an empty string while the kicker, date and bar fade; the background scales 1 to 1.06 throughout.
adapt: Change the kicker, title and date strings, the accent red and the background image; keep the 1s scramble with revealDelay, the 4x flicker at 57% and the 0.35s scramble-out.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the layers with placeholder scramble text; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with scrambleText tweens at 0.05D and 0.25D, flicker at 0.575D and exit 0.825D. Needs ScrambleTextPlugin registered; scope selectors to el.
caveats: the title starts visible with placeholder glyphs at frame 0 and empty at the last frame
background scale jumps from 1.06 back to 1 on loop
